newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares rise on rebound.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares rise on rebound.

text.p: Shanghai B shares ended up on a rebound for a second day but faced met heavy liquidation at high levels in the afternoon, brokers said.
The index rose 0.686 points or 1.51 percent to 46.200 points, on volume of 7.3 million shares worth $2.6 million. Of 41 B shares, 35 traded, with 20 up, nine flat and six down.
Brokers said that the rebound, which began on Tuesday, was unlikely to last long, with trading volume remaining low.
"Institutions with large positions actively did window-dressing buying and domestic investors helped push up the index by bargain-hunting selective stocks," one broker said.
"Technical charts indicate that the current rebound has peaked and the index will move back into a downward channel again in the coming days," another broker said.
Shanghai Sanmao Textile was the star on speculative buying, rising $0.016 or 14.28 percent to $0.128, on volume of 2,000 shares.
Shanghai Rubber Belt followed, jumping $0.014 or 11.47 percent to $0.136, on volume of 2,000 shares.
Shanghai Posts & Communications Equipment traded the most on a rebound after sharp losses in the past days, rising $0.012 or 4.65 percent to $0.270, on volume of 1.5 million shares.
Shanghai A share index dipped, with players interested only in speculative stocks, brokers said.

The index fell 2.993 points or 0.30 percent to 990.079 points, on volume of 396.7 million shares worth 3.6 billion yuan. The SSE 30 blue-chip index edged down 3.983 points or 0.16 percent to 2454.566 points.
Dongfeng Pharmaceutical was the biggest loser, falling 0.66 yuan or 4.16 percent to 15.18 yuan, on volume of 723,800 shares.
